name: Edit Image
description: FLUX.2 klein 4B. Upload a picture and say what to change. The rest of the picture stays the same (4 steps, about 1 megapixel).
promptGuide: Write the change as one short instruction, for example "make the sky a sunset" or "remove the car". Then say what must stay the same, for example "keep the people, the road and the light as they are". Do not describe the whole picture: the start image already shows it.
